digest.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
digest.tldr: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act.  Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

digest.title: ChatGPT is adding real cartoonists' signatures to fake New Yorker cartoons
Our approach to EU text provenance rules
digest.tldr: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules.  Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

digest.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
digest.tldr: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.
